question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution states that 'The Council of Ministers shall be collectively responsible to the House of the People'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 75 (3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The** **Constitution's** original text included **395 articles** divided into 22 divisions and 8 schedules.
 
• **Article 75 **in the constitution states that **The Council of Ministers shall be collectively responsible to the House of the People.**
 
• **Article 75(3)** of the Indian Constitution, which covers the unique requirements of this principle, contains the concept of **collective responsibility.**
 
• According to Article 75(3), the** council of ministers** must be assembled and **answerable to the Lok Sabha**. 
 
• According to the principle of collective responsibility, the** Lok Sabha is accountable **to the council of ministers for the **general management **of the government's operations. 
 
• **All decisions** made by the cabinet are a **collective effort** of the council of ministers, which functions as** a team.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 75 (2):**

 
 
• **​**The Minister will be in office as long as the President so directs.
 
 
 
• **Article 80 (4):**
 
 
• According to Article 80(4), the **elected members** of the State Legislative Assembly will **elect each State's delegates** to the Council of States. 
 
• This is in keeping with the proportional representation system that uses a single transferable vote.
 
 
 
• **Article 75 (1):**
 
 
• A **Council of Ministers** led by the Prime Minister **will assist and advise the President**, who will follow their recommendations when performing his duties. 
 
• The president may request that the council of ministers reevaluate this advise, and the president must then act in accordance with the revised advice.
